name: Playground animation onboarding guides user through squash, stretch, and stencil evaluation
description: Verify the dedicated /playground interactive tutorial: displays The Bouncing Mochi lesson, verifies Artisan Handbook animation theory, draws Frame 1 (Apex Float), Frame 2 (Kinetic Stretch), Frame 3 (Impact Squash), and validates timeline playback.

planSteps.description: Verify the Playground layout loads displaying the 16x16 beginner canvas and the Artisan Handbook panel on the right
Verify the lesson header shows 'The Bouncing Mochi' and explains squash, stretch, and mass invariance
Click on the canvas to paint a pixel for Frame 1
Click the Frame button in the bottom timeline to advance to Frame 2
Verify the Artisan Handbook updates to 'Frame 2: Kinetic Plummet' with stretch discipline guidance
Click on the canvas to paint a pixel for Frame 2
Click the Frame button in the bottom timeline to advance to Frame 3
Verify the handbook updates to 'Frame 3: Impact Squash' with ground contact guidance
Click on the canvas to paint a pixel for Frame 3
Click the 'Hide Lightbox' button in the Artisan Handbook panel to toggle tracing stencil visibility
Verify the lightbox tracing guide is toggled
Click the 'PLAY' button in the timeline
Verify the 3-frame bouncing animation plays continuously and completes the interactive onboarding milestone
